item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul drwa ba srid pa rab 'byams kyi rgyud las zhi khro ma gsum gyi tshogs 'khor bsdus pa gter gyi 'byung gnas
item.coloph: zhi ba gsas mkhar rab 'byams las/ khro bo bder gshegs 'dus pa yi/ ma mo srid pa spyi 'dul lho/ rnam gsum bka' yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ gcig tu dril ba'i gdams pa 'di/ zag med tshogs kyi 'khor lo ru/ kun grol grags pa'i dpal chen gyis/ nyer bsdus nyer mkho 'di spel dge/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ zhi khro ma gsum gyi tshogs 'khor gter gyi 'byung gnas 'di yang mched grogs dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgyes su bgyis pa shu b+ham//
